step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the "ECU Data Monitor" screen and check the computer data.

table.title: [System Selection Screen: Body → Pre-crash → ECU Data Monitor]

entry.ptxt: Indicates driver side seat belt fastening status
Driver side seat belt buckled: Buckled
Driver side seat belt unbuckled: Unbuckled
Driver side seat belt buckle status cannot be detected: Undetermined
If abnormal, a malfunction in the driver side buckle switch circuit is suspected
Indicates front passenger side seat belt buckle status
Front passenger side seat belt buckled: Buckled
Front passenger side seat belt unbuckled: Unbuckled
Front passenger side seat belt buckle status cannot be detected: Undetermined
If abnormal, a malfunction in the front passenger side buckle switch circuit is suspected
Indicates driver side seat belt control status
Driver side seat belt controlled: Controlling
Driver side seat belt not controlled: Control Stopped
Driver side seat belt control status cannot be detected: Undetermined
Operation stops when the overheat protection function is active
Indicates front passenger side seat belt control status
Front passenger side seat belt controlled: Controlling
Front passenger side seat belt not controlled: Control Stopped
Front passenger side seat belt control status cannot be detected: Undetermined
Operation stops when the overheat protection function is active
Display Range: (0) when normal, other than (0) when abnormal

step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the "Active Test" screen and perform the active test.

atten3.ptxt: If the active test is performed many times in succession, the overheat protection function of the motor in the seat belt operates, "PCS Currently Unavailable" is shown on the multi-display in the combination meter assembly, and control stops. When the temperature drops and pre-crash seat belt control becomes possible again, the display disappears and the system returns to the controllable state.

table.title: [System Selection Screen: Body → Pre-crash → Active Test]

entry.ptxt: Operates driver side seat belt motor (Operate/Stop)
Does not operate even if requested when the seat belt is not fastened
Operates front passenger side seat belt motor (Operate/Stop)
Does not operate even if requested when the seat belt is not fastened
